items.title: Honeymoon trip to Soviet Union (1988)
items.summary: As mayor of Burlington, VT, Sanders led a sister-city delegation to Yaroslavl, USSR in 1988. At the time he praised some aspects of Soviet social programs. These statements are documented and publicly available.

sources.name: Politico
sources.description: Reporting on archived footage of Sanders's 1988 Yaroslavl sister-city trip

sources.name: CCTV Center for Media & Democracy
sources.description: Burlington government access recording of Sanders press conference upon return from Yaroslavl

items.title: Campaign staff wage dispute (2019)
items.summary: "Given our campaign's commitment to fighting for a living wage of at least $15.00 an hour, we believe it is only fair that the campaign would carry through this commitment to its own field team." — draft letter from unionized field organizers, as quoted by The Washington Post (Sean Sullivan), 2019-07-18.
items.verbatimQuote: "Given our campaign's commitment to fighting for a living wage of at least $15.00 an hour, we believe it is only fair that the campaign would carry through this commitment to its own field team."
items.outcome: Campaign subsequently raised pay / limited hours so staff make the equivalent of $15 an hour (Washington Post, 2019-07-19).

sources.name: Washington Post
sources.description: Verbatim quote from organizers' draft letter; contested claim about campaign pay (alleged surface)

sources.name: Washington Post
sources.description: Outcome reporting: campaign limited hours so pay met $15/hr equivalent
